title: Responsible AI
standfirst: The ethical, legal and social questions raised by deploying AI at scale — with the technical mitigations available.

description_paragraphs: AI/ML systems are becoming increasingly pervasive in all facets of life. However, deploying large-scale AI without addressing ethical, legal, privacy, and societal concerns can lead to undesirable outcomes. This course introduces the fundamental principles of responsible AI deployment.
